headline: Meta Stock Slides After Sales Outlook Disappoints Amid Rising AI Costs
summary: Meta Platforms stock slid after the social media giant reported second-quarter earnings below expectations.  The Facebook parent's sales forecast was below estimates as well, while its AI spending forecast was upped slightly.  The Menlo Park, Calif.-based Meta earned $6.18 per share from sales of $60.8 billion for the June quarter, according to a company press release.
